newsitem.title: USA: Video Lottery picked for Fla. contract.
newsitem.headline: Video Lottery picked for Fla. contract.

text.p: Video Lottery Technologies Inc said on Friday its Automated Wagering subsidiary received a new five-year contract to continue operating Florida's lottery system.
The contract also has two, two-year renewal options, the company said.
Automated Wagering has been the on-line lottery provider for Florida for the past eight years, operating over 8,200 terminals throughout the state, the company said.
A dollar figure was not immediately available.
A Video Lottery spokeswoman said the contract is worth about $27.7 million annually, based upon prior year lottery sales in Florida.
